units: <cite ref="Eruvin 64a:9">Erub. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ אל יתפלל</he> an intoxicated person should not pray, contrad. to <he>שתוי</he> under the influence of wine.
Ib. שתוי … ש׳ שאין וכ׳ shathuy is he who could speak before a king (who could collect his mind, if he were suddenly summoned to speak &c.), shikkor is he who could not &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 31b:4">Ber. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ שמתפלל וכ׳</he> a drunk person that prays is like one worshipping an idol.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:2">Num. R. s. 10</cite>; Tanḥ. Sh’mini 11; a. fr.
